overlapCheck.method: exact trimmed text and id comparison against ALL FIVE prior sealed sets and ALL THREE development sets, asserted at build time with a throw

independentEvidenceExhaustion.status: THIS IS THE LAST FRESH STRIDE
independentEvidenceExhaustion.consequence: after this holdout the current field dataset is EXHAUSTED for fresh evaluation. No prior field scenario may be reused as fresh evidence. Any further semantic quality phase must identify a genuinely independent new source, and that source may not be authored solely to satisfy already-known failures.

A_independent.authoredBy: an earlier programme phase; never executed against any Level-3 code
A_independent.selection: deterministic -- indices where i % 5 === 3 over the id-sorted dataset, the rule L3-2e named in advance
A_independent.disjointFromPriorStrides: strides 0,1,2,3,4 are pairwise disjoint by construction; 3 is the last unused
A_independent.note: this stride finally brings in mobile_equipment, the last of the field dataset's six families that no sealed set had drawn from.

B_authoredComplement.why: source A is entirely positive hazards with no negative control, corrected state, clarification case, observation-availability case, predicate-scope case, token-boundary case or control-adequacy case
B_authoredComplement.limitation: authored by the implementer -- the FIFTH phase running to carry this, and the programme's largest unclosed methodological weakness. Written and frozen BEFORE the repair code, expectations declared here, no text reused from any prior set.

C_targetedFamilyComplement.authoredBy: the L3-2f implementation phase, FOR FAMILY COVERAGE ONLY
C_targetedFamilyComplement.why: noise_exposure is the one family still NOT_YET_SEALED_VALIDATED, and eight further families passed L3-2e only under a permitted ALTERNATIVE label rather than their own.
C_targetedFamilyComplement.limitation: TARGETED, not independent, and reported separately everywhere. Coverage evidence, not generalization evidence.

clarificationLabelContract.true_means: a decision-critical fact is missing and the correct semantic conclusion cannot be reached safely without it
clarificationLabelContract.false_means: the evidence already supports the semantic conclusion; a question would only add optional detail
